era: Legacy twitter.com layout (Jan to mid-July 2019), the default for every desktop user until the React redesign reached everyone on 2019-07-15; later-2019 React features (Share, Relevant people, Explore) are kept only where the legacy page had an equivalent

sources.shows: signed-in legacy home: top bar Home/Notifications/Messages, bird, Search Twitter, avatar, Tweet pill; profile card, trends, Who to follow, footer
signed-in legacy profile: banner, stats bar, Tweets / Tweets & replies / Media tabs
legacy profile: Tweets/Following/Followers/Likes stats, Following button, Tweet to / Message, Who to follow (Refresh, View all), Trends for you, reply/retweet/like/DM row
signed-out legacy profile: Home/Moments bar, Search Twitter, Have an account? Log in, Follow, New to Twitter? Sign up, footer Terms/Privacy policy/Cookies/Ads info, Joined date, Pinned Tweet

signed-out landing: blue panel with three lines, login fields, See what's happening in the world right now, Join Twitter today, Sign Up / Log in, footer About Help Center Blog Status Jobs Terms Privacy Policy Cookies Ads info Brand Apps Advertise Marketing Businesses Developers Directory Settings, (c) 2019 Twitter
legacy search: query band, Top/Latest/People/Photos/Videos/News/Broadcasts tabs, New to Twitter? Sign up
React redesign rolled out to all: Explore, Bookmarks, Lists, Profile, More in left rail; Share icon; dim and lights-out dark modes
the opt-in new layout of early 2019 (Explore, Bookmarks), not the default
landing markup: StaticLoggedOutHomePage communication items with edge-icons search/people/reply glyphs, StreamsFooter
